description: This Java class `MetadataHeadersValueValidator` is responsible for validating string values that should be parsed into `MetadataHeaders`. It attempts to parse the input and throws an exception if parsing fails, effectively ensuring that header values conform to the expected format.

classes.name: MetadataHeadersValueValidator
classes.description: A final class implementing a singleton pattern that validates string inputs by parsing them into MetadataHeaders objects and throwing detailed exceptions upon failure. It extends AbstractHeaderValueValidator and overrides the validateValue method.

methods.name: MetadataHeadersValueValidator()
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the validator with a condition that the expected JSON type is JsonArray.

methods.name: getInstance()
methods.description: Static method returning the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue(final HeaderDefinition definition, final CharSequence value)
methods.description: Overrides the abstract method to parse the value into MetadataHeaders; throws a DittoHeaderInvalidException with details if parsing fails.

methods.name: getDescription(final JsonRuntimeException jsonRuntimeException)
methods.description: Helper method to generate a detailed error message combining the exception message and optional description.
